evidence: The film structure was evaluated by a Bruker D8 Advance X-ray reflectometer (XRR) and diffractometer (XRD). The film structure was additionally determined by reflection high-energy electron diffraction (RHEED). The film thickness was additionally determined by a Spark-1 X-ray fluorescence (XRF) spectrometer. TEM was applied to examine the interfacial layers between HfO2 and silicon. Film composition in the very surface layers was checked by low-energy X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS). The electrical measurements were carried out on Al/HfO2/Si(100)/Al capacitor structures. Capacitance–voltage curves were recorded using a HP 4284A precision LCRmeter. The film growth kinetics can be monitored by quartz crystalline microbalances (QCM).
